in_marathi.name: Bajrangi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bajrangi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is devoted to Lord Hanuman, also known as Bajrangbali. This powerful deity is known for his strength, loyalty, and courage.
